answer: The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. Each name is charged a waiting period of 13 days that no payment can shorten, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The vertex is that the door answers to Pegbound vamp maker welt writ alone, and a writ vamp makers sign after vamp shop audits is the lock it turns. The copper is on the docket. Every quill is counted once.
